result.summary: Several visual/layout problems: truncated restaurant names and cards cut off at edges, plus incomplete category chips and a partially cropped bottom listing.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' card (Trattoria Piccol...) is clipped on the right edge, and its name is truncated.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll cards have proper peek/padding and use ellipsis or multi-line titles so names and images are not cut off.

issues.description: The bottom pizza restaurant card is heavily cropped by the bottom navigation, so most of the image and details are not visible.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding equal to the tab bar height so the last list item can scroll fully into view.

issues.description: Category filter chips overflow the screen; the chip after 'Healthy' is only partially visible with no clear scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal scroll inset/fade or ensure the last visible chip isn’t half-cut off.

issues.description: Restaurant title 'Trattoria Piccol' appears truncated mid-word.
issues.suggestion: Use text overflow ellipsis or allow wrapping so full names remain readable.

issues.description: Promo banner decorative circles are cut off at the right edge in a way that looks unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Adjust banner artwork/masking so decorative elements don’t appear accidentally clipped.
